checklist.title: Load every county, city and town
checklist.why: The Census of Governments 2022 list: 38,736 general-purpose governments with an official's title, address, website and FIPS codes. Everything else is keyed to it.

checklist.title: Download state statutes
checklist.why: open-us-law (Vaquill AI): one verified parquet file per state, each section with the URL of its government publisher. Arkansas, Colorado, Georgia, Mississippi and Tennessee are not in the current release.
checklist.cost: 867 MB for all states (VA 17 MB); regulations add 2.1 GB
checklist.detail: 47 states downloaded, 5 not in the release

checklist.title: Find the state law for each question
checklist.why: Ranks every section by title, chapter and text; a known section number is used only if it is found, in force and on topic. The method and a confidence score are stored with each result.
checklist.detail: Public records: 44 states; Start a business: 46 states

checklist.title: Find contacts on Wikidata
checklist.why: Official websites, emails and phone numbers from Wikidata (the data behind govdirectory.org), matched by FIPS code.
checklist.detail: 3 of 51 states checked; 4 governments with an email or phone

checklist.title: Pull two local models
checklist.why: Two model families (qwen3:1.7b and gemma3:1b) extract the steps independently; a model only reaches 'two models agree' when they match. Needs the Ollama service ('llm' profile).
checklist.cost: about 2.2 GB for the default pair; a GPU helps a lot

checklist.title: Build the state process models
checklist.why: Curated (checked) facts first; otherwise both local models extract quote-anchored facts, compiled to BPMN and DMN and checked (schemas, bpmnlint, quotes, Petri-net soundness).
checklist.detail: Checked by Claude or a person: 22; One extraction: 65; Law found, no steps yet: 3; No state law found: 14

checklist.title: Load checked local answers
checklist.why: Local procedures researched for particular places (curated/places/<state>/<place>.json): portals, offices, local ordinances and fees, each with its source. Scored as local law and contacts.

checklist.title: Score every government and refresh the maps
checklist.why: Confidence = state law + local law + contacts, with the weights on the Method page.

checklist.title: Look for records and licence pages on official websites
checklist.why: Reads each government's home page (robots.txt respected) for a public-records page, a business-licence page, and email or phone links.
checklist.cost: about 1 request per government; a few minutes per state
checklist.detail: 1 of 51 states scanned; 3 governments with a records or licence page

checklist.title: Scan local ordinances (LOCUS-v1)
checklist.why: Finds local ordinances on public records and business licences for each city and county. LOCUS is CC BY-NC and machine-labelled, so it is used to find law, never to cite it.
checklist.cost: ranged reads of a 1.8 GB dataset
checklist.detail: 1 of 51 states scanned; local law found for 110 governments

checklist.title: Find court decisions that cite the law
checklist.why: Searches CourtListener (Free Law Project) for opinions in each state's appellate courts that cite the sections behind its models. Shown on model pages, the wiki and the Wikibase.
checklist.cost: one request a second; about a minute per state
checklist.detail: 150 court decisions found for 4 states with models

checklist.title: Load the Lexipedia Wikibase
checklist.why: Statutes, process models and their steps, jurisdictions and the court decisions that cite them, as linked items in the wiki's own ontology (part of, follows, deontic modality, bearer, references).
checklist.cost: one edit per item; a few minutes

checklist.title: Publish to Lexipedia
checklist.why: Writes law and process pages to DokuWiki over JSON-RPC (bot account, API limited to @bots).
checklist.detail: 22 of 22 reviewed or agreed models published to https://lexipedia.xyz

checklist.title: Share through Turso
checklist.why: Push your results to a shared Turso (libSQL) database, or pull states other people have built.
